title: Minimum Window Substring
statement:
Given two strings s and t, find the minimum window substring of s that contains all the characters in t (including duplicates). If no such window exists, return an empty string.

A window substring is a contiguous sequence of characters from s. The characters in t can appear in any order within the window.
constraints: s and t consist of uppercase and lowercase English letters

visibleExamples.explanation: The minimum window substring is "BANC" which contains all characters in "ABC".
The entire string "a" is the minimum window.
No window can contain two 'a's from the string "a".
